entity.summary: Thailand-based centralized digital-asset exchange operated by Bitcoin Co. Ltd. The company voluntarily discontinued exchange and wallet services, ending all trading after September 30, 2019.
entity.notes: Bitcoin Co. Ltd. announced on September 2, 2019 that it would stop all BX.in.th trading after September 30, disable deposits on September 6, and cease seeking a Thai digital-asset exchange licence for 2020. Withdrawal and support access continued temporarily after trading ended. HEI uses voluntary_shutdown because the operator stated that it was redirecting focus to other business opportunities.

events.title: BX.in.th ended digital-asset trading
events.description: Bitcoin Co. Ltd. ended all purchasing, selling, and trading through BX.in.th after September 30, 2019 as part of a voluntary discontinuation of its exchange and wallet services.
events.notes: The website remained temporarily available for withdrawals, support, and outstanding issues, but the exchange no longer provided trading after this date.

evidence.title: SEC support after Bitcoin Co. Ltd. announced cessation of BX exchange services
evidence.notes: Primary regulator release quotes the operator's announcement and confirms that customers could no longer purchase, sell, or trade digital assets through BX.in.th after September 30, 2019.

evidence.title: SEC warning to BX clients after cessation announcement
evidence.notes: Primary regulator warning reiterates the end of exchange and wallet services and the September 30 end of trading while warning customers about transfer-related impersonation fraud.
